title: Newcastle hospital told woman whose unborn baby had died to go home and ‘book a slot to give birth’
summary_full: Trust admits Danielle Brown’s baby would have survived had she not been sent home from RVI days earlierA woman whose unborn baby had died was sent home from hospital with a booklet for bereaved parents and told to book a slot to give birth.Danielle Brown, 31, was seven months pregnant when she was first discharged from hospital with pre-eclampsia, a potentially life-threatening pregnancy complication. She returned to hospital days later, when scans revealed that her daughter, Maisie, had died. Continue reading...
